chapter.heading: Wise Sayings of Solomon
chapter.v:
The proverbs
of Solomon:A wise son makes a glad father,But a foolish son is the grief of his mother. [Jer. 25:15]

Treasures of
wickedness profit nothing,But righteousness delivers from death. [Jer. 25:17-19; Ezek.29:2–32:32 c 2 Kin. 23:33-35 d 2 Kin. 23:29; 24:7; 2 Chr. 35:20 e Jer.]

The Lord
will not allow the righteous soul to famish,But He casts away the desire of the wicked.

He who
has a slack hand becomes poor,But the hand of the diligent makes rich. [Is. 21:5; Jer. 51:11, 12; Joel 3:9; Nah. 2:1; 3:14]

He who
gathers in summer is a wise son;He who sleeps in harvest is a son who causes shame. [Jer. 49:29]

Blessings are
on the head of the righteous,But violence covers the mouth of the wicked. [Jer. 46:12, 16; Dan. 11:19]

The memory
of the righteous is blessed,But the name of the wicked will rot.

The wise
in heart will receive commands,But a prating fool will fall.

He who
walks with integrity walks securely,But he who perverts his ways will become known. [Is. 66:19]

He who
winks with the eye causes trouble,But a prating fool will fall. [Is. 34:6; Zeph. 1:7; Ezek. 39:17] [Is. 13:6; Joel 1:15 l Deut. 32:42; Is. 31:8; Jer. 12:12]

The mouth
of the righteous is a well of life,But violence covers the mouth of the wicked. [Jer. 8:22 o Is. 47:1; Jer. 31:4,] [Ezek. 30:21]

Hatred stirs
up strife,But love covers all sins. [Jer. 2:36; Nah.]

Wisdom is
found on the lips of him who has understanding,But a rod is for the back of him who is devoid of understanding. [Is. 19:1; Jer. 43:10, 11; Ezek.]

Wise people
store up knowledge,But the mouth of the foolish is near destruction. [Ezek. 30:18] [Jer. 44:1]

The rich
man’s wealth is his strong city;The destruction of the poor is their poverty.

The labor
of the righteous leads to life,The wages of the wicked to sin. [Lev. 26:36, 37; Jer. 46:6 v Jer. 51:9]

He who
keeps instruction is in the way of life,But he who refuses correction goes astray.

Whoever hides
hatred has lying lips,And whoever spreads slander is a fool. [Is. 47:4; Jer. 48:15; Mal. 1:14]

In the
multitude of words sin is not lacking,But he who restrains his lips is wise. [Jer. 48:18 y Is.]

The tongue
of the righteous is choice silver;The heart of the wicked is worth little. [Jer. 1:14] [Hos. 10:11]

The lips
of the righteous feed many,But fools die for lack of wisdom. [[Ps. 37:13];]

The blessing
of the Lord makes one rich,And He adds no sorrow with it. [[Is. 29:4]]

To do
evil is like sport to a fool,But a man of understanding has wisdom. [Judg. 6:5; 7:12; Joel 2:25] [Is. 10:34]

The fear
of the wicked will come upon him,And the desire of the righteous will be granted.

When the
whirlwind passes by, the wicked is no more,But the righteous has an everlasting foundation. [Ezek. 30:14- 16; Nah. 3:8 h Ex. 12:12; Jer. 43:12, 13; Ezek. 30:13; Zeph. 2:11 i Is.]

As vinegar
to the teeth and smoke to the eyes,So is the lazy man to those who send him. [Jer. 44:30; Ezek. 32:11 k Ezek.]

The fear
of the Lord prolongs days,But the years of the wicked will be shortened. [Is. 41:13, 14; 43:5; 44:2; Jer. 30:10, 11 m Is. 11:11; Jer. 23:3, 4; Mic. 7:12]

The hope
of the righteous will be gladness,But the expectation of the wicked will perish. [Jer. 10:24; Amos 9:8, 9 o Jer.]

The way
of the Lord is strength for the upright,But destruction will come to the workers of iniquity.

The righteous
will never be removed,But the wicked will not inhabit the earth.

The mouth
of the righteous brings forth wisdom,But the perverse tongue will be cut out.

The lips
of the righteous know what is acceptable,But the mouth of the wicked what is perverse.
